svg.text: How many R×C grids have a real word in every row and every column? ENABLE dictionary (172,823 words), repeats allowed.
Exact counts from exhaustive search. C×R has the same answer as R×C (transpose), so only R ≤ C is shown.
number of rectangles (and time to the answer, 32 threads)
not shown: 16–22 columns, 2–10 rows: all proven impossible (63 sizes)
